dimensions.summary: Local Capabilities owns one machine-local dictation-language choice; Home resolves it only for new availability, install and speech-session requests.
API, I18N, Settings and D-20260801-Persisted-Dictation-Language agree on strict CAS, six supported choices, new-session application and separate download authority.
Direct schema, service, IPC, registry, Settings and Home tests bind persistence and language resolution without claiming a broader speech or ingest exit.
A bounded dictation-language owner reuses machine settings and existing Speech capability APIs without duplicating microphone, asset-install or transcription ownership.
Existing API, I18N and Settings owners plus one durable Decision absorb the feature without a new document, audio persistence, hidden download or status promotion.
